title: The Brutal Origins of Bear-Baiting - Nautilus
gist: A paper in Society and Animals traces English bear-baiting back to the Norman Conquest of 1066. Literary, artistic, and archaeological evidence shows the practice became much more common after William of Normandy's victory, and the Bayeux Tapestry depicts a chained, muzzled bear.
